study_name: Allen Brain Cell Atlas: MERFISH whole mouse brain, C57BL6J-638850 (Yao et al. 2023)

source.notes: Expression release 20230830 with the 20231215 metadata release (the latest cell_metadata for this matrix). One adult male C57BL/6J mouse, 59 coronal sections, 500-gene panel run on a Vizgen MERSCOPE. Coordinates are published in mm and converted to um; no per-section imagery is published (CCF volumes only).

panel.panel_name: Allen Institute whole mouse brain MERFISH 500-gene panel
panel.description: 500 genes selected from the 10x scRNA-seq taxonomy to distinguish whole-brain cell types (Yao et al. 2023).

C57BL6J-638850.description: The single C57BL/6J mouse of the Allen MERFISH-C57BL6J-638850 release; sex and genotype (wt/wt) as the cell metadata records them. Age is not in the release metadata and is left null.
